Independent exact Fraction arithmetic formed all three absolute facet functionals, all switching parameters, and 48 open parameter intervals over m∈[0,1/2], with candidate polynomial set exactly {1,1+m−m²,1+2m−3m²}; every difference from the last was checked nonnegative at interval endpoints and its quadratic critical point. The uniform witness x=(1,1), y=(0,-1) has norms 1, N(mx+(1−m)y)=1−m and N(x−y)=2. Symmetry completes full lambda∈[0,1], maximal value 4/3 exactly m=1/3 and balanced value 5/4. This is a finite rigorous reduction followed by exhaustive exact rational algebra, not sampled-grid inference.
